categories.summary: Inside/outside/on-path profiles via clipper2 containment-aware tool-radius offset; open paths always on-path (Easel semantics). Inner contours cut before outer via containment depth. Climb/conventional is opt-in, enforced by shoelace-orientation reversal on closed toolpaths, with entry rotated to the longest-segment midpoint. NaN vertices dropped pre-clipper. No arc lead-ins (documented deferral).

categories.summary: Two strategies: contour-parallel offset rings (innermost-first, boundary wall ring last as finishing pass, each ring offset from original contours to avoid error accumulation, 4096-ring backstop) and opt-in raster X/Y serpentine sweeps (ADR-105 G10) reusing the laser fill-hatching engine. Islands handled by containment-aware offsets. Stepover clamped 10-85%. No adaptive/trochoidal clearing, no wall finish allowance.

categories.summary: 'Drill' cut type: every closed shape becomes one hole at its bounding-box center with an explicit peck cycle (step down depthPerPass, retract to stock top to clear chips, repeat), encoded as path3d since GRBL lacks G81/G83. Whole cycle pinned to the plunge feed at compile. No point-object drilling, no dwell-at-bottom, no configurable retract height, no peck-vs-plain choice.

categories.summary: True V-carving via inward offset ladder z(d) = -min(d/tan(θ/2), maxDepth) converging to the medial axis (ADR-098 H.3); cone-height cap prevents modeling deeper than the bit's flank (VCarve-style flat-depth limit); auto resolution tool/8 with 0.1 mm floor, 8192-ring backstop. Two-stage clearing pockets flat floors with a separate flat bit before the v-bit ladder. Analytic perceptual test proves a 90° bit carves the exact pyramid frustum through the real pipeline.

categories.summary: Holding tabs on profile cuts: passes below tab-top skip tab windows, an extra pass lands exactly at the tab top so height never quantizes to the pass grid, bridge width compensated by tool diameter, hole slugs tabbed too. Default remains tabsEnabled:false with depth == stock (M-17); mitigated post-audit by a through-cut-without-tabs advisory (CNC-06). Ramp entry opt-in (along-path descent + level re-cut). Lead-ins v1 = start at longest-segment midpoint; arc leads and drag-placeable tabs deferred.

No finishing allowance / stock-to-leave for profiles or pockets.
